answer: A per-identity stake bond is the cleanest Sybil brake: each wallet locks tokens before attesting, and the bond is slashed if the identity proves to be a duplicate. A farmer funding N heads pays N bonds while reward per head stays flat, so cost rises linearly and break-even leaves reach. A rate-limited queue and a trust spiral that thickens only over many epochs force a fresh cluster to start at zero standing. Bonds cost capital, the queue and slow trust curve cost time, and the system keeps no free vine to climb. Like a glacier, mass identity creation grinds down instead of paying off.
